verdicts.reason: A: the text block sits high above the jar's centre line, the NEW badge has shrunk to an unreadable speck floating on its own below the copy, and a large dead gap separates the copy from the CTA, which sits off the headline's axis. B has the same speck-sized, orphaned NEW badge, the same empty middle and an over-large gap between headline and subline, and its jar label is tiny, but the jar, copy and CTA share a centred axis, so the layout reads as more intentional.
